about: Which engine re-voices a character's edited lines from the Mission Editor's re-voice queue. Characters not listed use Kokoro with their registered approved voice (tools/audio/generate.py --from-queue). Nothing here changes a registered voice (tools/audio/npc-voice-registry.json). ElevenLabs lines are NOT generated by any tool in this repository: they wait in the queue until the owner approves the spend. "model": the ElevenLabs model (void-runner/npc-voices.js MODELS); a character without one uses Eleven v4. Voice tags such as [whispers] are sent only to models that read them (Eleven v4, v3).
